== Biography ==
Janet was born before 1809. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-2963|Robert Glasgow]] and [[McConechie-2|Jean McConechie]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2963]] is assessed at 81% (probable). The held FamilySearch baptism account places Janet Glasgow in 1809 in the Robert Glasgow/Jean McConechie family, with mother spelled Jean McConnochy. The repeated couple is persuasive, but the c.1780 child/trust-beneficiary story on Robert’s profile lacks an adult bridge.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Inspect the baptisms and parents’ marriage for adult occupation/residence.
